% bibentry's \nobibliography, which writes \bibdata as \bibliography
% does: a .bbl beside, without the .bib, gives the entry in the text.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{natbib}
\usepackage{bibentry}
\begin{document}
\bibliographystyle{plainnat}
\nobibliography{test-bblnobib-gone}
The entry: \bibentry{one}.
\end{document}
